chapter: Haiti, Artie Shaw and Los Angeles work
title: Recording 'Autumn Leaves' with Shaw; talk sessions with the group
summary: Collins played on one of the first recordings of Autumn Leaves with Shaw, and the group spent rehearsals talking, which Joe Benjamin loved.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: So any way I did quite a bit of recording with -- we did quite a bit of recording with Artie at this time, as a matter of fact I did one of the first -- Was Dr. Hayakawa at the session?
Yeah, yeah. We did the first -- one of the first recordings on what is it, falling leaves? (Humming of music.) What is that, the falling leaves?

Any way, and we had --'Autumn Leaves', that's it. And they had a monologue on here, some man by the name of Tom Scott. Yes, it was -- he was -- I guess it was a great recording. Yeah, yeah, very good recording. But any way I enjoyed working with Artie because we'd have some sessions or just gab fests. We'd rehearse a while and we'd talk most of the time. The whole group. And of course Joe Benjamin, boy, that was -- he loved that, because he would get into these heated conversations,he and Billy -- well, we all did really. But it was a very enlightening experience also.
You and Joe were very good friends.
